mapper.update: UPDATE ranking_item SET agree_count = GREATEST(agree_count + #{dAgree}, 0), oppose_count = GREATEST(oppose_count + #{dOppose}, 0), participant_count = GREATEST(participant_count + #{dParticipant}, 0), agree_rate = CASE WHEN participant_count + #{dParticipant} > 0 THEN LEAST(GREATEST((agree_count + #{dAgree}) / (participant_count + #{dParticipant}), 0), 1) ELSE 0 END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{itemId}
